acceptanceCriteria: Given a customer purchases a return trip ticket with a promo code applied, when the Mozio confirmation email is generated, then the promo code discount amount is visible for both the outbound and return portions of the trip in the email body.

Given a customer purchases a one-way trip ticket with a promo code applied, when the Mozio confirmation email is generated, then the promo code discount amount continues to be displayed correctly (no regression).

Given a return trip where the promo code discount exceeds the return fare portion, when the Mozio confirmation email is generated, then the displayed promo code amount for the return portion does not exceed the return fare subtotal.

Given a return trip ticket with a promo code applied, when the confirmation email is rendered in both HTML and plain text formats, then the promo code discount amount is present in both formats for the return leg.
